_comment: Scene prompts for the 78 Starlit Tarot card illustrations. style is prepended to every scene so the set stays consistent. source is the public-domain fairy tale the scene draws from (shown in the deck viewer). Scenes stay tied to the card's upright meaning in src/vue/site/features/tarot/tarot.ts.
style: Dark fairytale oil-and-digital painting, painterly brushwork with fine linework, Gothic chiaroscuro, deep navy and midnight teal shadows, antique gold rim light, one cold moonlight source, muted wine-red accents, atmospheric haze, full-bleed painting that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, no card frame, no border, no margin, no watermark, no text, no letters, no numerals

back.scene: A midnight forest lake reflecting a huge pale moon, a constellation of gold stars drawn across the dark sky in a ring, a crescent moon at the centre, the surface of the lake perfectly still, no figure, symmetrical composition.

cards.scene: A lone traveller with a small bundle steps off the edge of a dark forest path onto a misty cliff, breadcrumbs glowing faintly behind him, a white dog at his heel, a bright gap of moonlit sky ahead.
A gaunt sly figure at a spinning wheel in a candlelit stone room, straw turning into gold thread under his hands, a table of tools and glass vials, the golden spool glowing.
An antique silver hand mirror standing behind a dark veil, its glass reflecting a moonlit scene hidden from the room, a sealed scroll at its feet, Snow White's magic mirror.
A crowned woman in a flowing dark gown seated in an overgrown garden of blood-red roses and thorned vines, a ripe pomegranate in her hand, a castle half-hidden behind the vines.
A stern crowned king seated on a grey stone throne in a cold ashen hall, a heavy iron sceptre across his knees, a midnight clock visible in the dark, ash drifting like snow.
An elderly storyteller in a dark robe at a hearth reading from a huge leather book, listeners as silhouettes around the fire, old tales carved into the stone walls, a bronze key hanging on a chain.
A pale mermaid and a young man in a dark coat face each other across a moonlit shoreline, their hands almost touching, a choice between sea and land, a silver knife glinting on the sand between them.
A black coach drawn by six gaunt grey horses races across a moonlit road, its wheels sparking, a figure in a torn grey cloak holding the reins firmly, a clock tower striking midnight behind.
A warrior woman in dark armour kneels calmly beside a fallen banner, her hand resting gently on a great grey wolf that lowers its head, a bent sword stuck in the earth, a quiet moonlit field.
A hooded old figure stands alone at a dark forest crossroads, holding a small brass lantern whose light reaches only a few steps through the trees, mist curling around the roots.
Three spinners at a great turning wheel in a vast dark hall, threads of gold and grey running from the wheel up into the night sky, a broken crown rolling across the floor.
A stern judge with a balance scale standing before a dark forest courtroom, a red-cloaked girl on one pan and a shadowy wolf on the other, a feather and a sword laid on the table.
A young man hangs upside down by a braid of golden hair from a high stone tower window, calm and still, the moonlit forest far below, ivy climbing the tower.
A tall pale figure in a black and white robe stands at a frozen threshold holding an hourglass, a child's small bed beyond a door left open, cold white light, snowflakes drifting.
A girl in a dark dress slowly pours clear water from one silver jug into another beside a moonlit stone fountain, a goose with silver-tipped feathers at the edge, a quiet balance.
A shadowy horned silhouette of a nobleman holding a key hangs over two chained figures in a dark chamber, the chains loose at their wrists, a locked door ajar behind them, a candle guttering.
A tall tower of cracked mirror glass struck by lightning, shards falling through the night air, a lone figure falling from a high window, a dark storm sky.
A young girl in a tattered grey dress kneels by a frozen river on a winter night, holding out her apron as gold coins fall from the starry sky like shooting stars, a lone bare birch tree.
A dark forest path under a huge pale moon, a small figure in a red hood walking away, a wolf's pale eyes watching from behind the trunks, mist on the road.
A golden bird with blazing feathers perched on a black branch above a dark courtyard at dawn, warm golden light spilling over a stone fountain and pushing back the night.
A glass coffin in a dark forest clearing, a pale woman inside beginning to stir as a crow circles overhead, a prince kneeling beside it, petals drifting, a trumpet-call of awakening.
A girl and a boy stand at the edge of a dark forest at dawn, pearls and jewels glinting in their hands, a small cottage in a clearing beyond, a wreath of stars above.
An old bronze lamp on a stone ledge, a single bright flame rising from its spout into the night, desert dunes below a palace silhouette.
A figure in a dark cloak stands on a palace balcony holding a small globe, looking toward a dark desert with a road of lamplight, a second fire burning behind.
Three tall wooden staves planted in a sandy ridge, a caravan of silhouettes departing on the horizon toward a distant palace under stars.
A torch-lit feast in a dark ruined hall, guests as silhouettes raising cups around a long table, garlands of dark roses between tall staves.
Five young knights in mismatched armour clash wooden staves in a muddy courtyard, dust and sparks rising, a hooded watcher observing from the gate.
A victorious rider on a grey horse rides through a cheering dark crowd of silhouettes under a laurel of thorns, a banner with a golden crest.
A lone warrior defends a narrow bridge with a long staff against a dark press of shadowy figures climbing up from below, moonlit fog.
Eight burning staves streak across a dark sky over a sleeping village, trails of ember light.
A wounded but upright soldier leans on a staff at a barricade of thorned timber in a dark forest, bandaged, watchful eyes in the firelight.
A lone figure carries a towering bundle of heavy staves across a snowy moonlit path toward a distant castle.
A young squire with a feathered cap holds a single staff lightly, a sprouting green twig on its tip, a dark road ahead with a tiny lantern.
An armoured knight on a rearing black horse charges down a torchlit forest path, a red banner streaming, sparks flying from the hooves.
A regal woman on a throne carved with lion heads, a dark golden sunflower in one hand and a staff in the other, a black cat at her feet, a fire burning in a hearth behind.
A bearded king on a throne of charred wood, a flaming staff in his hand, a salamander coiled around the throne's arm, lit by a dark fire.
A silver chalice rising from dark sea waves, its brim overflowing with glowing water and a single white lily, the moon above.
A mermaid and a young man exchange a silver cup on a moonlit shoreline, their reflections meeting in still water.
Three mermaids dance on a rocky shore holding golden cups aloft under a full moon, laughter as silhouettes, seafoam rising.
A melancholy young man sits under a gnarled tree by a still lake, three cups set before him on the grass, a pale hand offering a fourth cup from a cloud.
A figure in a dark cloak stares at three spilled cups on a stone bridge, two cups still standing behind, a river of moonlight, a castle in the distance.
Two children in old-fashioned clothes stand in a garden of white flowers, a silver cup of blossoms passed between them, a half-ruined stone manor behind.
A young figure stares up at seven cups floating in the night sky, each holding a different vision: a castle, a crown, a serpent, a veiled face.
A pilgrim with a staff walks away from eight stacked golden cups on a dark shore toward a moonlit mountain path.
A satisfied man in a feathered hat sits at a table with nine cups arranged in an arc before him, a warm dark tavern lit by candles.
An arc of ten cups hangs over a distant moonlit cottage, two figures and children dancing hand in hand in a silver meadow.
A young page in a dark tunic holds a single cup from which a small fish-tailed creature peeks, standing at the sea's edge.
A knight in silver armour on a white horse rides along the shore, offering a cup, waves breaking, a ship on the horizon.
A queen seated on a throne at the edge of the sea, gazing into a large silver chalice that mirrors a drowned palace, her feet in the tide.
A bearded king on a throne in the sea, a golden cup in his hand, fish and a ship carved on his throne, storm clouds behind him.
A single gleaming sword pierces a moon-shaped crown, held upright by a gloved hand emerging from storm clouds.
A blindfolded woman sits on a stone bench between two crossed swords before a dark sea at night, the moon veiled by cloud.
Three swords pierce a red heart floating in a dark rainy room, a grey figure weeping by a window.
A knight lies on a stone effigy tomb in a silent chapel, hands folded, three stained-glass windows of moonlight, a sword laid beside him.
A victorious soldier holds a bundle of swords and stands over two retreating figures on a windy battlefield at dusk, looking back at the wreckage.
A ferryman poles a small boat across a dark misty river carrying a veiled woman and a child toward a distant shore.

cards.source: 阿里巴巴（偷偷離開的人）
cards.scene: A sneaking figure carries five swords away from a dark camp, glancing back over a shoulder, tents with a cloth tied at the flap.
A blindfolded woman stands loosely bound by ropes of thorn inside a ring of eight upright swords in a foggy marsh, a castle on the cliff ahead, her feet free.
A woman sits upright in bed in a dark room, head in her hands, nine swords painted like a tapestry on the wall behind her, moonlight through a small window.
A fallen figure lies face down on a dark shore with ten swords across its back, a pale dawn breaking on the far horizon.
A young scholar in a dark cloak holds a sword upright while reading a scroll by a lantern in a stone archive.
A knight in dark armour charges across a windy plain on a black horse, sword raised, a storm cloud behind him.
A stern queen in dark mourning dress seated on a throne, a sword resting across her knees, a raven perched on the chair back, a pale sky.
A grey-bearded judge-king on a stone throne holds a sword upright, a balance scale and a raven beside him, in a cold dark hall.
A single large gold coin rests on a dark velvet cushion, glowing in a hand emerging from a stone archway, a golden goose flying overhead.
A juggler balances two coins in a rope-walking dance over a dark river, two ships rising and falling in the waves behind.
Three craftsmen in a stone cathedral workshop compare a carved coin, a mason and a goldsmith at work, arches of dark stone, candlelight.
A stern merchant clutches a chest of gold coins, a coin on his crown and one under each boot, seated in a dark counting house.
Two ragged figures trudge through falling snow past a glowing stained-glass church window, bread and coins scattered in the snow, the window's warm light.
A wealthy patron on a stone step hands out coins to kneeling beggars, a balance scale held in his other hand, a dark city street.
A farmer leans on a hoe in a dark field of grown vines, seven gold coins hanging like fruit from the plants, at dusk.
A young craftsman carves gold coins at a workbench under a single lamp, a row of finished coins on the bench, sparks of gold dust in the air.
An elegant woman in a dark gown stands in a walled garden of grapes, a falcon on her gloved hand, nine gold coins in the grass.
Several generations of one family gather at the entrance of a grand manor, a stone arch wreathed in ivy, a fountain and gold coins on the steps.
A young scholar in a dark coat stands in a field studying a single gold coin in his palm, a rolling dark landscape beneath the stars.
A knight in heavy dark armour sits motionless on a patient draft horse in a ploughed field, a gold coin glinting on the horse's harness.
A warm woman with a wicker basket of fruit and coins sits in a dark garden of roses and herbs, a black rabbit at her feet, a cottage behind her.
A bearded king on a throne of carved oak in a treasury, gold coins in piles at his feet, a golden bull carved on the armrest, stern and calm.
